title: The Scream (Edvard Munch)
moodDescription: Existential dread and emotional tension under a blood-red sky

regions.label: The Screaming Figure
regions.spokenLabel: A gaunt, ghostly figure at the center, hands pressed to its face, mouth wide open in an eternal scream, draped in dark clothing.
regions.timbreDescription: Distorted expressive cello and dissonant lead

regions.label: Fiery Sky
regions.spokenLabel: A blazing sky of swirling red and orange bands, rippling like waves of heat across the entire upper portion of the painting.
regions.timbreDescription: Ominous shimmering brass and high tension harmonics

regions.label: Bridge & Railing
regions.spokenLabel: A wooden bridge with strong diagonal railings stretching from the foreground into the distance, with two shadowy figures walking away.
regions.timbreDescription: Heavy wooden contrabass and creaking resonant pulse

regions.label: Fjord Waters
regions.spokenLabel: Deep blue swirling waters of the fjord, with dark undulating currents and a pale yellow shoreline glowing in the distance.
regions.timbreDescription: Dark flowing arpeggiated piano and watery textures

regions.label: Swirling Shoreline
regions.spokenLabel: The right side of the painting where the earth and water merge in sweeping curves of ochre, green, and deep blue.
